title: ‘Love Island USA’: Here’s Where to Watch the Season 8 Finale Online
summary: The Islanders are entering their final night in the villa, while America's vote decides which couple walks away with the season 8 title.
contentText:

The Love Island USA villa is preparing to close its doors for another summer, with just six couples still in the running for the $100,000 grand prize.

Hosted by Vanderpump Rules star Ariana Madix, the hit Peacock dating series returned in early June with a new group of singles hoping to find love. Weeks of bombshell arrivals, dramatic re-couplings and the show’s signature Casa Amor twist have reshaped the competition, leaving only a handful of Islanders standing ahead of the season 8 finale.

Watch Love Island USA Season 8 Finale Online, at a Glance:

- Date & Time: Sunday, July 12, at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT

- Stream: Peacock

get peacock

Before America crowns its favorite couple, one more round of eliminations will narrow the field from six couples to four. Those finalists will be revealed during tonight’s episode before heading into the final weekend of the season.

The Love Island USA season 8 finale on Sunday, July 12, at 9 p.m. ET/6 p.m. PT, when viewers will finally learn which couple walks away with the title and the $100,000 prize. The reality dating show streams on Peacock .

How to Watch Love Island USA Season 8 Online

The streaming platform doesn’t offer a free trial, but does come with a couple of affordable plans starting at $10.99 per month. In addition, you can get 30 days of access to Peacock for as low as $1 with Walmart+ , as one of the service’s benefits and perks. Learn more about Walmart+ and Peacock here .

There are two different plans offered on Peacock: The Premium Plan for $10.99 per month or the Premium Plus Plan for $16.99 per month. If you’re looking to save, you can save 17% off when you do the annual plan for $109.99 per year or $169.99 per year. With the Premium Plan, it’s ad-supported and you’ll receive access to a wide range of movies, TV shows, originals, live sports from NBC Sports and live news from NBC News.

Peacock’s Premium Plus plan comes with everything in the Premium plan , no ads, your local NBC channel live and the ability to download and stream offline.

Alongside Love Island USA , you’ll have access to the entire Peacock library, including Wicked: For Good , Yellowstone , Five Nights At Freddy’s , The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills , Poker Face , Saturday Night Live and others.

The streaming service also offers a number of music documentaries and specials, such as Toby Keith: An American Icon , Bowie: The Man Who Changed The World , Bob Dylan: The Folk Years , Stevie Nicks: Through The Looking Glass , Katy Perry: Main Square , Welcome To The A: 50 Years of Hip-Hop in Atlanta and more.

Meanwhile, those who want to watch internationally can access the streaming service with a VPN , such as ExpressVPN with prices starting at $2.79 per month for 28 months, paired with Peacock.

What to Expect From the Love Island USA Season 8 Finale

Filmed at a private luxury villa in Fiji’s Mamanuca Islands, the finale gives the remaining couples one last chance to celebrate their relationships before returning to the real world.

As in previous seasons, the finalists will head out on romantic final dates, which have included scenic boat rides, candlelit dinners and intimate picnics. The dates often give Islanders the opportunity to discuss what life outside the villa could look like and whether their connections can survive beyond the show.

Afterward, the couples will dress for the season’s final ceremony, where Ariana Madix will reveal America’s vote and crown the winning couple. Following weeks of dramatic challenges, unexpected romances and emotional twists, the finale will determine which pair formed the strongest connection and earns the $100,000 prize.

From couples who have stayed together since the beginning to Islanders who found love after Casa Amor shook up the villa, season 8 has delivered plenty of memorable moments. Now, only one couple will leave Fiji as this summer’s Love Island USA champions.

Love Island USA Season 8 Cast

The cast of Love Island USA season 8 features the brother of Charlie Georgiou from season 7, the daughter of a retired-NBA player and others. However, cast member Vasana Montgomery was removed from season 8 due to a scandal over the use of a racial slur . See the list of the cast participating in the new season below.
